items.response:
Here's what Jess should weigh: the monthly math (would rent cover the mortgage, condo fees, property tax and a vacancy cushion), how much cash selling would free up after agent fees and any tax on the gain, and whether she needs that cash for something else in the next couple of years. Then the non-money side: does she actually want to be a landlord, and what does she expect from the market and her own plans in two years. Tax treatment of selling versus renting can differ a lot, so a short chat with an accountant before she decides is worth it.
Action: Send you this as a short checklist to pass to Jess, and look up the specific tax rules if you tell me which province the condo is in.

I can look for plumbers who can come today or Monday for the dripping outside tap and the hose that won't shut off. One quick thing in the meantime: if you can find the inside shut-off valve for that line, closing it should stop the drip until they arrive.
Action: Search for plumbers near your home with availability today or Monday and show you the options with ratings and callout fees; I'd confirm which time window works for you before booking anyone.

PAY-1216, the 'my payout is late' support macro, isn't a formal blocker but needs your tone review and Support wants it before GA, while PAY-1203 and PAY-1211 aren't blocking. That snapshot is weeks old, so I'd confirm the statuses live before you rely on it.

I'd check your notes and past lesson prep for your weak spots first, then build 8-10 questions on those, mixing quick recall with a few fill-in-the-blank sentences. If I can't find a list, tell me two or three topics and I'll build it from those.

Action: Search your reno notes, the contractor quotes and any email threads with the other two for the comparison, then send you a short summary to show Sam; if nothing was written down, I'll tell you that plainly.

TFSA: you contribute with after-tax money, growth and withdrawals are tax-free, and the room comes back the next year. RRSP: contributions are tax-deductible and grow tax-deferred, but withdrawals are taxed as income, so it tends to win when your tax rate now is higher than it will be in retirement.
Action: None needed, but I can help work out which fits you and Sam better if you want to look at your contribution room.

Claro, vamos de una en una para que sean diez minutos. Pregunta 1: ¿el o la? ___ mapa, ___ mano, ___ problema. Después seguimos con día, tema, idioma, foto y radio.
Action: Run the 8-10 question quiz one at a time, focused on the masculine -ma words and the feminine -o exceptions, and give you a score and your misses at the end.

Here's the plan for the sheet: three sections, with ser vs estar for emotions and locations first, por vs para second, and the subjunctive after cuando for future actions third, each with 8-10 fill-in-the-blank items and an answer key. Your own example goes in section three as a correction: 'cuando llego a casa te llamo' becomes 'cuando llegue a casa te llamo'.
Action: Build the drill sheet with the three sections and an answer key, save it, and send it over before your next lesson.

Saved: Spanish vocab lists will come as a table with Spanish, English and an example sentence. Here's a start for the doctor's visit.

| Spanish | English | Example sentence |
|---|---|---|
| el dolor de cabeza | headache | Tengo dolor de cabeza desde ayer. |
| la fiebre | fever | Creo que tengo fiebre. |
| la receta | prescription | ¿Me puede dar una receta? |
| la alergia | allergy | ¿Tiene alguna alergia? |
| la cita | appointment | Necesito una cita con el médico. |

Action: Expand this into a full role-play list (symptoms, body parts, questions the doctor asks, medications) in the same table format and give you an Anki-ready version before Tuesday.

Roughly: a heat warning means two or more days of daytime highs around 31°C with overnight lows around 20°C, or a humidex of 40 or more. An extended heat warning covers a longer stretch, about three or more days, which is when cities like Toronto step up measures such as opening cooling centres. Exact thresholds can vary by region, so I'd double-check the alert text.
Action: Pull the current Environment Canada alert for your area and tell you which one it is and when it ends, if you want.

They come from Lisbon, specifically the Belém neighbourhood. Monks at the Jerónimos Monastery were making them in the early 1800s, and when the monastery closed in 1834 the recipe was sold to a nearby bakery, Pastéis de Belém, which opened in 1837 and still makes them. Kid version for Leo: the monks had leftover egg yolks and turned them into custard tarts.
Action: None needed; I can find a kid-friendly recipe if Leo wants to make some.
